summary.en: Site, topography, access, buildings, solar arrays, energy distribution and revision-ready equipment in one editable drawing.
summary.zh: 在一张可编辑图纸中组合场地、地形、道路、建筑、光伏阵列、能源网络与可修订设备。

summary.en: A bounded civil plan with synthetic contours, roads, buildings, utilities, planting, dimensions and title information.
summary.zh: 包含图框、示意等高线、道路、建筑、管线、绿化、尺寸与标题信息的土木场地总图。

summary.en: A sheeted floor plan with grids, walls, columns, doors, windows, room labels, furniture and dimensions.
summary.zh: 带图框的首层平面图，包含轴网、墙柱、门窗、房间标注、家具与尺寸。

summary.en: A station-based road profile with existing ground, design grade, grid, drainage, structures, labels and dimensions.
summary.zh: 按桩号组织的道路纵断面，包含现状地面、设计坡线、网格、排水、构造物、文字与尺寸。

summary.en: A millimetre manufacturing sheet with orthographic geometry, holes, centre lines, section hatching, dimensions and notes.
summary.zh: 毫米制制造图，包含正投影几何、孔、中心线、剖面线、尺寸与技术说明。

summary.en: A parametric face and section drawing for a 120 mm flange with a 40 mm bore and six through holes on a 90 mm pitch circle.
summary.zh: 120 毫米法兰的参数化端面与剖面图，包含 40 毫米孔和 Ø90 节圆上的六个通孔。

summary.en: A dimensioned sleeve sheet with front, side and section views, centre lines and a title block.
summary.zh: 带正视、侧视与剖视、中心线、尺寸和图签的轴套图纸。

summary.en: An editable mounting plate drawing with hole spacing, dimensions, side view and notes.
summary.zh: 带孔距、尺寸、侧视图和技术注释的可编辑安装板图纸。

summary.en: A bracket sheet with orthographic views, an editable rib detail, holes and native dimensions.
summary.zh: 包含正投影视图、可编辑加强肋、孔和原生尺寸的支座图纸。

summary.en: A repeated hole pattern with centre lines, dimension chains and an inspection-ready sheet layout.
summary.zh: 以中心线、尺寸链和检验图幅组织的重复孔位图纸。

summary.en: A not-to-scale office concept with editable rooms, circulation, doors and windows.
summary.zh: 包含房间、动线和门窗的可编辑办公概念平面（非比例）。

summary.en: Coordinated door and window elevations with editable marks, sizes and a compact schedule.
summary.zh: 带可编辑编号、尺寸与简表的门窗立面图。

summary.en: An editable distribution one-line with feeder, protective devices, branch circuits and load labels.
summary.zh: 带进线、保护器件、分支回路与负荷标注的可编辑配电单线图。

summary.en: A not-to-scale courtyard concept with editable paths, planting and seating.
summary.zh: 包含步道、种植区与座椅的可编辑庭院概念平面（非比例）。

summary.en: An editable schematic of inspection chambers, gravity pipes, flow arrows and a legend.
summary.zh: 带检查井、重力管、流向箭头和图例的可编辑排水示意图。

summary.en: A section showing footing, wall stem, backfill, drain and editable hatch patterns.
summary.zh: 展示基础、墙身、回填、排水与可编辑填充的剖面图。

summary.en: A typical trench schematic with duct bank, bedding, warning tape and clearance annotations.
summary.zh: 包含管群、垫层、警示带与净距标注的典型管沟示意图。

summary.en: A turned shaft with stepped diameters, keyed section, orthographic views and native dimensions.
summary.zh: 带阶梯轴径、键槽段、正投影视图与原生尺寸的可编辑传动轴图。

summary.en: A keyed hub detail with coordinated front and section views, bore and hub dimensions.
summary.zh: 带正视与剖视、轴孔和轮毂尺寸的键连接零件详图。

summary.en: An editable linkage plate with slot, end holes, centre lines and dimensioned views.
summary.zh: 带长圆孔、端孔、中心线与尺寸视图的可编辑连杆板。

summary.en: A bearing support housing sheet with bore, mounting holes, section and native dimensions.
summary.zh: 包含轴承孔、安装孔、剖视和原生尺寸的轴承座壳体图。

summary.en: An editable concept detail pairing chamber plan and section, pipe penetrations and cover.
summary.zh: 将井室平面与剖面、管道穿墙和井盖组合呈现的可编辑概念详图。

summary.en: An editable concept road section showing carriageway, shoulders and pavement layers.
summary.zh: 展示车行道、路肩与路面结构层的可编辑道路概念断面。

summary.en: A twin-cell culvert concept section with wall and slab geometry, openings and labels.
summary.zh: 带墙板轮廓、双孔洞口与标注的可编辑箱涵概念剖面。

summary.en: An editable bridge pier concept elevation showing cap, column, foundation and piles.
summary.zh: 展示盖梁、墩柱、基础与桩基的可编辑桥墩概念立面。

summary.en: Line, circle, arc, ellipse, closed polyline and bounded hatch generated as native editable CAD entities.
summary.zh: 以原生可编辑 CAD 图元生成直线、圆、圆弧、椭圆、闭合多段线与有界填充。

summary.en: Three native hatch patterns and an unfilled island, with editable boundary polylines and DXF output.
summary.zh: 三种原生填充图案与一个留白岛洞，边界多段线可编辑，并可导出 DXF。

summary.en: Aligned, radius, diameter and three-point angular dimensions backed by a named dimension style.
summary.zh: 由命名尺寸样式驱动的对齐、半径、直径与三点角度尺寸。

summary.en: Editable TEXT and MTEXT exercise a local CJK-first font fallback stack and Unicode engineering symbols.
summary.zh: 可编辑 TEXT 与 MTEXT 验证本地中文优先字体回退和 Unicode 工程符号。

summary.en: A paper-space A4 landscape sheet with explicit margins, 1:1 plot settings and vector print output.
summary.zh: 纸空间 A4 横向图纸，包含明确页边距、1:1 出图设置与矢量打印输出。

summary.en: A compact DXF 2018 source is imported with original handles, editable geometry and UTF-8 engineering text.
summary.zh: 紧凑的 DXF 2018 源文件保留原始句柄、可编辑几何与 UTF-8 工程文字后导入。

summary.en: A deterministic move demonstrates edit history, undo, redo and atomic rejection of an invalid edit.
summary.zh: 确定性移动用于验证编辑历史、撤销、重做以及无效编辑的原子拒绝。

summary.en: One native block definition is inserted three times with independent position, scale and rotation.
summary.zh: 一个原生块定义以独立位置、比例和旋转插入三次。
